agentPane.debug.subagentTray.why: On by default; deleting the off switch keeps the subagent tray.

agentPane.debug.needsYouPill.why: Off because it does not work yet (Leo 10-23: 'default off ... bc it doenstr work rn... we need to fix it'); fix it, then flip.

agentPane.debug.needsYou.why: Applies only while the Needs you App Store item is installed; it is that item's look, not a gate.

agentPane.debug.thoughtFoldThreshold.why: A look comparison; the default (every thought, Leo 10-20) is the chosen one.

agentPane.debug.thoughtHeader.why: A look comparison between duration and first line; the default is the chosen one.

agentPane.debug.topStripStyle.why: A look comparison for the composer's top strip; the default is the shipped look.

agentPane.debug.sidebarPreviewVariant.why: A look comparison for the sidebar preview; the default is the shipped look.

agentPane.debug.turnActionsPlacement.why: A look comparison (left as Claude Code desktop, or right); the default is the shipped look.

labs.previewFeatures.why: Gates several unfinished surfaces at once (music, Click by Hint, Stats, the App Store page); each ships by leaving the gate, not by flipping it.

labs.voiceRoom.why: Records mic and screen text and posts them to a room: a privacy switch only the person turns on.

labs.voiceRoomURL.why: Voice Room's server address, a value and not a switch.

labs.machineJoin.why: Mints a line that joins any machine to the team: a network switch only the person turns on.

labs.liveCode.why: Loads Swift patches into the running app: a switch only the person turns on.

agent.chromium.why: Kill switch for the agent chat in Chromium: off returns to WebKit, which shows window glass through the page and Chromium does not.

agent.composerPlainFooter.why: A look comparison for the composer footer; the default plain look (Claude Code desktop's) is the chosen one.

agent.escapeStopDoublePress.why: On by default, as in Claude Code; deleting the switch keeps the double-press Esc and drops the old single-press stop.

agent.harnessPlacement.why: A look comparison of four model picker layouts; the default top row of symbols is the chosen one.

agent.harnessSwitchInStartedChat.why: Off is the chosen behavior (a started chat's harness is fixed, as in Claude Code); the switch only restores the old harness rail.

agent.modelMenu.why: Compact and full are two menus people may want; the compact default is the chosen one.

agent.openOutsideChatsViewOnly.why: Off on purpose: Leo 10-21 'I want it to steer by default'; the switch only offers view-only opening.

agent.pageHost.why: Off until the move to the shared page host is finished; the Chromium switch already turns it on, so this one goes with the old host.

agent.pairGuard.why: Safety kill switch: on pauses two agents messaging each other in a loop; off is only for debugging the daemon.

agent.pointerInspector.why: A kill switch for the page inspector Leo asked for; it can be turned off at runtime.

agent.reasoningSlider.why: An opt-in look for the reasoning menu, off by default; the list of levels is the shipped look.

agent.reasoningSliderStyle.why: A look comparison for the opt-in reasoning slider; the default accent thumb is the chosen one.

agent.sessionStatus.why: Off by default so far: the plan and recap cards are a Claude Code desktop look nobody has asked to make default.

agent.suggestedTasks.why: Forces suggested tasks on over the real Settings option, so it is a test override, not a gate.

agent.systemDictation.why: Off by default so the pane's own dictation runs; the switch keeps macOS dictation as a fallback.

agent.updatePeers.why: A kill switch: it stops cmux from updating other machines' daemons on its own, which can interrupt a running agent.

agentActivity.layout.why: A layout comparison for the Agent activity pane; the split default is the shipped look.

agentChat.browserOpensPreview.why: On by default (Leo 10-20); deleting the off switch keeps one Browser button that opens the chat's page.

agentChat.terminalButtonAdds.why: Leo 10-15 said the Terminal button should add a terminal on the right each click, not toggle; it was built only as an off switch.

appearance.borders.why: A look choice that also overrides cmux.json; None is the only way to see the app with no borders, and the default is the chosen look.

apps.section.look.why: A look comparison for app sidebar sections; the card default is the one Lawrence picked.

auth.signInWindow.why: Lets testers pick where sign-in opens; Automatic is the chosen default and the choice is read at sign-in.

browser.swipeNavigation.why: On by default and still needs macOS's own swipe setting; deleting the switch keeps swipe back and forward.

browserHost.helperPrototype.why: A Debug-build-only prototype of a separate Chromium app, off because it is unfinished.

browserImport.folderGrant.why: On by default; deleting the off switch keeps asking for each browser's folder and drops the old read-everything path.

browserImport.suggestionCards.why: On by default; the browser.import.enabled setting already turns the cards off, so deleting this keeps the cards.

browserPage.loadingBackground.why: On by default; deleting the switch keeps pages loading on the theme color and drops the white flash.

browserPage.uiPointer.why: Off while the first slice of the page element picker is still being tried out; it is not finished.

chiefPet.uploadAffordance.why: A look comparison of three ways to offer upload; the default plus tile is the chosen one.

chrome.interfaceSize.why: Opt-in scale for chrome sizes, off on purpose until Lawrence promotes it; Interface Scale stays hidden from Settings.

chrome.mainPane.curved.why: A Debug override of the appearance.chromeStyle setting, which is the real control for the curved pane.

chrome.tabs.compact.why: Off on purpose: the familiar tab strip is the chosen look (Lawrence 10-14) and the tight strip is opt-in.

chrome.tabs.rowTools.why: On since Leo asked for tools in the tab row on 10-20; deleting the switch keeps them there and drops the old second row.

cloud.machines.layout.why: A layout comparison for the Cloud machine list; the rows default is the chosen one.

cloud.updateMachines.why: A kill switch for automatically updating Cloud machines, which also touches machines where an agent works.

cmuxTUI.restartUnresponsive.why: A kill switch for a new automatic restart of a stuck cmux-tui; keep it until the restart has proven safe.

coderouter.surface.why: Native is the default; the React CodeRouter page is an opt-in comparison, not yet chosen to replace it.

debugSettings.surface.why: The React page is already the default; deleting the switch keeps it and drops the old Swift Debug Settings view.

diagnostics.hangFiles.why: A diagnostic tool that writes a stack file for each main-thread hang; the switch lets people stop the logging.

drop.overlay.spring.why: A motion comparison for the drop overlay; the default is the shipped feel.

drop.overlay.style.why: A look comparison of twelve drop overlay styles; the default outline is the chosen one.

feed.layout.why: A layout comparison for the feed panel; the list default is the shipped look.

focus.flashOnMove.why: Off until Leo judges the focus-ring flash live (code comment); the feature is not yet accepted.

focus.inactiveTabStyle.why: A look comparison for unfocused pane tabs, also set from cmux.json; the default is the shipped look.

focus.indicator.why: A look choice for what marks the focused pane, and it overrides cmux.json; the default is the chosen one.

glass.lens.why: A look comparison for window glass; plain is the default and the Toggle Liquid Glass Lens action uses this choice.

history.menuLayout.why: A look comparison for the Back and Forward menu; the default scope-then-window is the shipped layout.

home.chatHeader.why: Leo turned the header off on 10-21 and Lawrence turned it back on 10-23; both looks were wanted, so the choice stays until settled.

home.chiefViewGallery.why: Dev and nightly only: offers experimental Chief views for trying out, not a shipped feature.

home.firstRun.hero.why: On by default (Leo 10-19); deleting the off switch keeps the Chief hero and drops the old rows-only panel.

home.flightRecorder.why: A diagnostic that records Home transcript blinks; it costs main-thread time, so it stays opt-in.

home.flightRecorder.captures.why: A diagnostic that saves window pictures of your conversation; it is a privacy opt-in and stays off in released builds.

home.headerPanelToggles.why: Off on purpose (Lawrence 10-22, header buttons were confusing); the switch brings the Memory Inspector toggle back.

home.launchIntoHome.why: On by default (Leo 10-19); deleting the off switch keeps first launch opening Home, not an empty New Tab workspace.

home.loneConversationRail.why: A look comparison; off was chosen after visual QA so a lone Chief gives the chat the full width.

home.richTables.why: On since Leo asked for it on 10-20; deleting the switch keeps table cards and plan cards and drops the plain-text table path.

home.topFadeStyle.why: A look comparison of eight top-fade styles; the background tint default is the chosen one.

home.turnProgress.why: A look comparison for the Chief's running indicator; the default (steps plus thought, Leo 10-20) is the chosen one.

home.voiceInput.why: Also drives Settings > Chief > Voice input, a row from Leo's list (#23781) people see in DEV and NIGHTLY; not a Debug-only switch.

hostPressure.banner.why: A new dev surface kept off on purpose (cmux#22662); the indicator alone ships first and the banner is unfinished.

hostPressure.enabled.why: Off on purpose (Lawrence 11-02); the palette's Show Host Pressure Warning turns it on, and off means no timer or reads.

hostPressure.force.why: A test hook that shows the host pressure indicator at a forced level with sample numbers.

hostPressure.style.why: A look comparison for the host pressure indicator, which is itself off by default; the gauge is the default look.

icons.family.why: A look comparison between the shipped icon pack and a custom family; the pack default is the chosen one.

launch.markStyle.why: A look comparison between trace and bloom for the launch mark; bloom is the default.

layout.prototype.dockEdge.why: Option of a view-only layout model prototype that is off by default; the prototype is not finished.

layout.prototype.dockMode.why: A knob for the unfinished layout frame prototype; its docked workspaces are off by default.

layout.prototype.model.why: A view-only layout prototype for trying other layout models; off because it is experimental.

layout.prototype.orientation.why: A frame prototype comparison (column-major or row-major docks); column-major is the default and the choice is still read.

links.agentLinks.why: A kill switch for cmux://agent links, which open sessions (hq#2555); a security gate worth keeping.

macScreen.sharingLook.why: A look comparison for the Screen Sharing page's This Mac section (Lawrence 11-07); the list is the default.

motion.pane.variant.why: A motion comparison for pane close and expand; the standard movement is the shipped one.

navigation.mouseSideButtons.why: On by default; the switch was only there to turn it off while new. Deleting it keeps mouse buttons 4 and 5 as back and forward.

newTab.layout.why: A design comparison for the new tab screen; design B is the default and A is still selectable.

newTab.picksFollowLinks.why: A placement comparison; the default (open where links do, Lawrence 10-19, restated 11-05) is chosen, and the alternative (replace the page) was Leo 10-20.

newTab.privateChatLists.why: Off by default; the on path is the old per-page chat list. Delete the switch and keep the shared list.

newTab.widgets.why: Off by default so the New Tab page stays calm (Leo 10-18); the widgets are an optional extra.

notifications.attention.look.why: A look comparison for the notification ring; subtle is the chosen default and strong is the old ring.

palette.itemActions.why: A prototype comparison of Tab on a palette row; the default menu is the shipped behavior.

palette.scopeChip.why: A look comparison for the palette scope chip, marked as a prototype; the default is the current look.

palette.scopeEntry.why: A comparison of prototype gestures for entering a palette scope; the default with all gestures is the one in use.

palette.tabSearchStyle.why: A layout comparison for Search Tabs; the recent list is the default.

panes.mainPane.why: A Debug override of the layout.mainPane setting, which stays the real control.

quickComposer.floatingChat.why: Off because the floating chat is still a prototype waiting to be styled into the app.

server.agent.allowRegister.why: A guard: until the bundled cmux ships `cmux host run`, registering the server agent would make launchd restart it forever.

settings.diagnosticToast.why: A look comparison of how long the ignored-setting toast shows; the default 12-second toast is the chosen one.

settings.presentation.why: Chooses whether Debug Settings opens as a tab or a window; the tab default is chosen and the window is used by benchmarks.

sidebar.agentMark.why: An R79 prototype of brand marks on sidebar rows, off because it is not finished.

sidebar.allChats.design.why: A marked-temporary vote between three All chats row looks; the default (Age) stays until the vote is settled.

sidebar.collapseMotion.why: An opt-in animation comparison; slide is the shipped behavior and the fade variant is a prototype.

sidebar.doneFold.why: On by default (Leo's sidebar organization); deleting the off switch keeps the Done (N) row and drops the unfolded list.

sidebar.evenRowText.why: On by default (Leo 10-20); deleting the off switch keeps even row spacing and drops the fixed 12 pt step.

sidebar.groupByStatus.why: Off because it is an opt-in sidebar grouping (Leo 10-14); the normal grouping stays the default.

sidebar.groupHeader.why: A look comparison for group headers; the solid band default is the shipped look.

sidebar.groupLineLayout.why: A look comparison for the group line shape; the edge default is the shipped look.

sidebar.hoverCardEscapeSlot.why: Off by default, and the shipped fix lines the hover card's top up with its row; delete the switch and keep that.

sidebar.laneFixture.why: A test hook that fakes agent states on rows for captures; it must stay off for real use.

sidebar.laneStatus.why: Off by default (Lawrence 10-21); the switch adds agent lane state to row status marks.

sidebar.multiView.why: A multi-view prototype that is off because it is not finished.

sidebar.notificationBadge.why: A look comparison for unread badges; the classic look is the shipped default.

sidebar.notificationIcon.why: A look comparison of bell versus inbox glyphs; the bell default is the chosen one.

sidebar.nowLine.why: Off by default (Lawrence 10-21); the switch adds a 'Now:' second line to working rows.

sidebar.presenceDots.why: Off until the dots are styled into the row (code comment); the feed runs either way.

sidebar.pullRequestBadges.why: On by default; the off path only hides pull request badges when the session tree is off. Keep badges on.

sidebar.pullRequestCard.why: On by default and read in one place; deleting the switch keeps the pull request hover card and drops the never-chosen off path.

sidebar.quietUnnamedRows.why: On by default (Leo 10-20, unnamed rows cluttered the sidebar); deleting the switch keeps them dimmed and drops full-ink names.

sidebar.remoteMachines.resources.why: A look comparison for how a machine's RAM and cores show; the row default is the shipped look.

sidebar.rowBadge.why: A look comparison for a row's badge; the one-glyph corner badge is the chosen default.

sidebar.rowBadgePreview.why: A preview tool that adds sample rows to compare badges without real sessions; it must stay off.

sidebar.rowBadgeStack.why: A value comparison (3, 5 or 7 glyphs); five is the default Leo chose, adjustable.

sidebar.rowCloseSpot.why: A look comparison for the row close button; the end default is Leo's choice (10-27).

sidebar.rowStatus.why: Off by default (Lawrence 10-21); it only adds state words to the row's screen-reader label.

sidebar.rowTitle.why: A look comparison of four workspace row name styles; the workspace-only default is the chosen one (Leo 10-26).

sidebar.rowTitlePreview.why: A test aid that adds sample workspaces to the sidebar to compare row names; off in real use.

sidebar.rowTitleSingleChat.why: Off by default; a row-name look choice that Leo asked to try, still compared against the default.

sidebar.sections.localPrototype.why: A stopgap that edits sections in memory until the daemon serves the sidebar layout; remove it then.

sidebar.sections.look.why: A look comparison of three section styles; the quiet default is the chosen one.

sidebar.sinceLooked.why: On by default; deleting the off switch keeps the hover card line about what agents did since you looked.

sidebar.toggleIcon.why: Icon candidates for review; the default stays until one is picked.

sidebar.updateCard.automaticControl.why: A look comparison for the update card's Automatic Updates control; the switch is the default look.

sidebar.updateCard.button.why: A look comparison of update button fills; the primary default is the chosen one.

sidebar.updateCard.layout.why: Three Restart to Update layouts for Leo to pick from (#39682); the card default stays until he picks one.

sidebar.updateCard.simulatePending.why: A test hook that pretends an update is staged to show the Update Ready card; nothing installs.

sidebar.workspaceTitleMotion.why: An animation comparison for late and renamed titles; the roll default is the current look.

sidebar.workspacesAsTabs.why: An off-by-default prototype that remaps Cmd-Shift-[ and ]; changing the default would change the shipped keys.

status.iconSet.why: A look comparison of status icon sets that the Debug menu also writes; the Codex-like default is the chosen one.

status.indicator.style.why: A look comparison that overrides the status indicator style everywhere; the arc default is the shipped look.

status.static.shapes.why: A look comparison for the static status look; the default glyph set is Leo's call.

status.working.why: A look comparison for the working indicator; the spinner is the default and the breathing dot blinks.

tabs.hoverPreviews.why: A look choice Leo asked for on 10-14 (Compact or Full); Full is the default until it becomes a real setting.

tabs.loadingAnimation.why: A motion comparison for busy tab indicators; instant is the production default until a variant is chosen.

tabs.separators.why: On by Lawrence's call (11-05: a subtle line between all horizontal tabs and before +); the switch stays as a look toggle.

whatsNew.design.why: A look comparison among What's New page designs; the sheet is the current default.

window.dockedWorkspaces.why: A default-off prototype of docking whole workspaces to window edges; its actions refuse while off because it is unfinished.

workspaces.autoName.variant.why: A behavior comparison for auto names (live label or persisted); persist is the default and live is still read.
